summary: Home touches a flattened O to the chin and then to the cheek, from EAT plus SLEEP squeezed together.
steps: Bring your fingertips together in a flattened O.
Touch it to the side of your chin.
Move it up and touch the cheek.
note: HOME is historically EAT (at the mouth) plus SLEEP (at the cheek): the place where you eat and sleep. Over time the two signs merged into the double touch.
mistakes: Touching the same spot twice. Chin, then cheek.
